summary: Enhance your procurement skills with our E-Procurement Training Course. Learn the latest strategies and tools to streamline your purchasing process effectively.
lede: E-procurement uses digital systems to manage purchasing from requisition and sourcing through ordering, receipt, invoicing, and supplier performance. For procurement professionals and administrators, training covers practical ways to map source-to-pay workflows, analyse spend, configure approval controls, and reconcile orders with invoices. Learners also examine supplier onboarding, catalogue governance, sourcing evaluation, and procurement reporting to support traceable transactions and monitor adoption.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, operate, analyse, govern, or support digital purchasing processes. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a practical understanding of e-procurement controls and workflows.
modules: Spend Analysis with Excel and Power BI
prerequisites: Working exposure to purchasing, procurement, accounts payable, supplier management, finance operations, or ERP transactions is useful but not mandatory. No programming experience is required. You should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheets, process diagrams, purchase orders, invoices, and basic procurement reports. Advanced platform configuration, API development, and software engineering are outside the completion requirements.
